item.title: Correction · MB4E: Curtis Development and Bayview Senior Services are the developers; Mission Bay 4 East Associates, L.P. is the Phase I entity and Mission Bay 4 East Associates 2, L.P. the Phase II entity. The tentative parcel map is dated March 31, 2026 and Public Works issued its approval notice on April 2, 2026; neither creates the lots. Construction start and completion dates are expected dates.
